column3: Close to the Hebrew; “for your judgments they stand this day” is rendered “They continue this day according to Your ordinances.”
Close to the Hebrew; “to all perfection I have seen an end” is rendered “I have seen the consummation of all perfection, But.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV makes “You” the subject and renders the singular “it is with me” as “they are ever with me.”
Close to the Hebrew; מִזְּקֵנִים (“than the elders”) is rendered “than the ancients.”
Close to the Hebrew; נִּמְלְצוּ (“are smooth”) is rendered “How sweet,” and the singular “word” “words.”
Close to the Hebrew; “I have inherited” is rendered “I have taken as a heritage.”
Close to the Hebrew; עֵקֶב (“to the end”) is rendered “to the very end.”
Close to the Hebrew; סֵעֲפִים (“the divided”) is rendered “the double-minded.”
Close to the Hebrew; וְאִוָּשֵׁעָה (“be saved”) is rendered “I shall be safe,” and “have regard for” “observe.”
Close to the Hebrew; “you make cease [as] dross” is rendered “You put away… like dross.”
